drafted_from: tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/tool-rows.json (tool:clone-speech-that-repair-could-not-fix), do-work/clone_speech.py, speaker_check.py, grade_and_repair_speech.py (write_result), read-data/phrases.py; no test runs the clone stage
start_here: Say to your AI: "Re-voice in the speaker's own voice, with their agreement, the spans still graded clone in /Work/demo/out, using the reference /Work/demo/ref/clean_0.50.wav whose words are 'alpha bravo'." It runs tool:clone-speech-that-repair-could-not-fix on your computer and tells you which spans were cloned or refused.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it updates grades.json and audio files in the output folder a grade made, from a spans file and a reference recording on your computer.
instructions: 1. Confirm that the reference is a clean recording of the speaker in the spans and that the speaker agreed to be cloned; tool:pick-the-cleanest-speech-to-clone-from finds one.

2. Run tool:grade-and-repair-speech-audio (stage all) first, so the output folder holds grades.json and the spans graded clone; keep the same spans file and settings (they need clone_model, read_model, speaker_similarity_min).
3. Say "Clone the spans that repair could not fix". Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs its run command with the spans file, settings, output folder, reference and reference_text.

4. Read the last JSON line and grades.json: a cloned span has cloned true and a clone entry (phrases, stretch_min, stretch_max); a refused span has not_cloned with the reason (voice not verified, no words with times, or no passing take) and keeps its best remaster. Show a cloned span as cloned wherever it is used, then run tool:read-back-repaired-speech.

worked_examples.title: Nothing graded clone: the span grades are left as they were
worked_examples.ask: Re-voice the spans that repair could not fix, from the reference I picked.
worked_examples.given: Worked out from do-work/clone_speech.py and grade_and_repair_speech.py write_result, not run here (it needs the clone model, pyannote and whisper weights). The output folder is the one the real `grade` run made from the test fixture (one good, two remaster, zero clone). The AI reads the row with this tools:list call, then runs: python3 trillion-workshop/tools/grade-and-repair-speech-audio/do-work/clone_speech.py --spans /Work/demo/spans.json --settings /Work/settings.json --out /Work/demo/out --reference /Work/demo/ref/clean_0.50.wav --reference-text "alpha bravo". The loop only visits spans whose grade is clone, so it checks no speaker and clones nothing.
worked_examples.hands_back: It prints nothing per span, rewrites grades.json from the saved state, and prints {"result": {"grades": "/Work/demo/out/grades.json", "counts": {"good": 1, "remaster": 2, "clone": 0}}}. Had a span been graded clone and its speaker similarity been under speaker_similarity_min, it would instead print the span id and "voice not verified as the reference voice (similarity <value> < <min>)", and grades.json would carry not_cloned for it.
